flow: ui-path — real navigation to the site's own results URL + rendered DOM read-back (no synthetic requests)

steps.note: {q} is URL-encoded. One trusted navigation per query (same as a human typing in the search box); the site's own JS fetches and renders the results. Optional captured session pre-answers the consent wall.
UNVERIFIED candidate — results render inside web-components; may need pierce/shadow handling (ytd-video-renderer a#video-title).

UNVERIFIED candidates — read title + href per row (href carries ?v=<videoId>); channel + metadata from sibling nodes (ytd-channel-name, #metadata-line). Both selectors expected to pierce light DOM (YouTube exposes slots); confirm on first live capture.
infinite feed — read stops at stableMs after the first N rows; never scroll unless args.scroll is added later

rpc: none — deliberately no direct innertube (/youtubei/v1/*) calls; that would be fabricated traffic. The page itself issues every request.
stealth: real browser, real navigation, read-only DOM — indistinguishable from a human search
notes: SCAFFOLD, DOM-UNVERIFIED — no live round-trip performed. ytd-video-renderer / a#video-title are prior-UI-knowledge candidates; YouTube ships frequent UI revisions — re-tune on first live capture.
